answer: One workable design: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because thread only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, onyx is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any yarrow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
